title: office.session-brief request
description: Assemble the deterministic brief for the current workspace. Call before opening a new conversation source. Optionally pass the current session's project and orchestrator to lead with that thread's handoff and list other recent threads in other_sessions; with no project the legacy single-conversation output is returned. No inference or writes.

project.description: Current project (repository name or working-directory path, normalized to the repository name). Absent or null keeps the legacy output.

orchestrator.description: Current orchestrator (for example claude or codex); inside the project, its thread's handoff leads. Absent or null means no orchestrator preference.
